CustomField.description: When checked, exposes the Edit row action on Repeater and Table sections. Passed as allow-edit to c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table. Button text comes from Edit Action Button Label and the edit modal uses Edit Action Modal Title/Subtitle.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on to let users edit existing rows in this repeater or table. Customize the button and modal wording with the Edit Action Button Label and Edit Action Modal fields.
CustomField.label: Enable Edit Action
